system_description.narrative_title: Bond-market rout and the Fed/Treasury policy squeeze
system_description.narrative_summary: The dominant narrative is a global bond-market selloff driven by persistent inflation, a surge in oil prices, and shifting central-bank expectations that have pushed the US 10-year yield toward the 5% threshold. Markets are pricing imminent Fed tightening under Warsh while US Treasury interventions (Scott Bessent’s buybacks/jawboning) and political signals (Trump comments, fiscal risk) struggle to contain long yields, re‑pricing risk across equities, housing, commodities and emerging markets.
system_description.scope: US and global government bond markets and yields; central-bank policy decisions and expectations (Fed, BoJ, ECB); inflation readings and commodity drivers (oil, gold); US Treasury debt issuance and interventions; major market participants (banks, hedge funds, institutional investors); related exchange-rate and mortgage-rate effects.
system_description.super_system: Global financial and macroeconomic system (monetary policy, sovereign debt, international capital flows)
adjacent_subsystems: Commodity markets (oil, gold) and inflation pass-through
evidence_headlines: Global Bond Selloff Deepens as 10-Year Yields Hit Multiyear Highs
The Fed Is Poised for a Rate Hike. It Rarely Stops at One.
Bessent Can Hold Down the Long Bond, But He Can’t Make the Bill Disappear
US consumer prices accelerate in August, push Fed closer to rate hike
Oil and Treasury yields haven’t moved this closely in seven years. That’s bad news for markets

variables.name: Long-term nominal government bond yields
variables.description: The prevailing nominal interest rates on long-dated sovereign bonds as priced in financial markets.

variables.name: Monetary policy rate expectations
variables.description: Market-implied and forecasted path for short-term central-bank policy rates over the policy horizon.

variables.name: Term premium
variables.description: The additional yield investors require to hold longer-dated bonds versus the expected path of short rates.

variables.name: Inflation rate
variables.description: The rate of change in the general price level of goods and services over a given period.

variables.name: Inflation expectations
variables.description: The market and household expectations about future inflation over various horizons.

variables.name: Oil price
variables.description: The spot or front-month market price of crude oil, affecting production costs and import prices.

variables.name: Sovereign debt issuance rate
variables.description: The flow of newly issued government debt offered to the market over a defined period.

variables.name: Central bank market operations
variables.description: The sequence and scale of liquidity provision, asset purchases/sales and other market operations conducted by monetary authorities.

variables.name: Sovereign market-support operations
variables.description: Government interventions in debt markets such as buybacks, reinvestments or ad hoc support operations.

variables.name: Market liquidity
variables.description: The ease and cost of executing transactions in bond and related markets, as reflected in spreads and depth.

variables.name: Risk premia across assets
variables.description: The additional returns demanded by investors for bearing various market, credit and duration risks across asset classes.

variables.name: Exchange rate levels
variables.description: The prevailing bilateral or effective values of major currencies relative to others, affecting trade and capital flows.

variables.name: Mortgage borrowing rates
variables.description: Typical quoted interest rates for long-term residential mortgage loans that influence housing demand and affordability.

variables.name: Credit spreads
variables.description: The yield differential between non-sovereign credit instruments and comparable risk-free government bonds reflecting credit risk.

variables.name: Investor risk appetite
variables.description: The collective willingness of market participants to hold risky assets versus safe assets, varying with sentiment and conditions.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flows
variables.description: Net flows of capital across borders into debt and equity instruments, including portfolio and direct investment flows.

catalysts.title: Fed policy-rate decision
catalysts.description: The Federal Reserve's policy meeting and rate decision expected mid-September, which will materially reprice short-rate expectations and long yields.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Fed's table is set for a rate hike', 'The Fed Is Poised to Raise Interest Rates', 'Fed rate-hike case builds'.

catalysts.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent congressional testimony
catalysts.description: Scott Bessent's testimony before Congress could clarify Treasury buyback strategy, sanctions stance and market support plans, shifting bond market sentiment.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'What to watch as Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent testifies', 'Bessent Can Hold Down the Long Bond', 'Bond Market Rejects Bessent’s Buyback'.

catalysts.title: UK gilt auction: £4.75bn
catalysts.description: Scheduled UK Treasury auction of £4.75bn in gilts next week that will add supply to the gilt market and test investor demand.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'UK to auction £4.75 billion in treasury gilts next week'.

catalysts.title: Sustained oil-price upside
catalysts.description: An ongoing oil-price rally (>$100) that is feeding inflationary pressures and raising rate-hike odds, likely to persist near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Global bond sell-off reignites as oil jumps to $109', 'Gold Stays Under Pressure as Oil Heightens Inflation Fears'.

catalysts.title: Continuation of global bond selloff
catalysts.description: Ongoing global bond selloff and repricing to multi-year highs that could further widen term premia and stress market liquidity.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Global Bond Selloff Deepens', 'Global bond yields hit 2008 highs', 'Bond Market Turmoil Is a Warning Shot'.

catalysts.title: Possible Vietnam sovereign dollar bond sale
catalysts.description: Vietnam considering its first sovereign dollar bond sale since 2014, which would add EM supply to dollar markets and attract cross-border flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'EXCLUSIVE: Vietnam considering first sovereign dollar bond sale since 2014, sources say'.

catalysts.title: Bank of Japan policy decision / market reaction
catalysts.description: BOJ decision or guidance that could disappoint markets (or surprise) and precipitate volatile yen moves and cross-border capital shifts.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Yen rally faces moment of truth as BOJ risks disappointing markets', 'Fed and BoJ expect rate hikes'.

catalysts.title: Re-pricing of multi-hike Fed path
catalysts.description: Market consensus shifting to price multiple Fed hikes over the next year, lifting short- and long-rate expectations and mortgage costs.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'No one and done: The Fed will hike at least two times', 'Fed rate-hike case builds', 'The Fed Is Poised to Raise Interest Rates'.

catalysts.title: Hedge-fund deleveraging and liquidity stress
catalysts.description: Hedge funds, positioned as 'wild cards', could deleverage into thinner markets, amplifying selloffs and widening risk premia.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Hedge Funds Are the Wild Card in the Turbulent Bond Market'.

catalysts.title: US Treasury buyback / market-support actions
catalysts.description: Potential continued or adjusted Treasury buyback and market-support operations as officials respond to high yields and market stress.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Bessent Can Hold Down the Long Bond', 'Bond Market Rejects Bessent’s Buyback', 'Bessent Brings a Pea Shooter to a Trillion'.
